findings.priority_reason: P2 indicates changed outcomes in an existing flow, as JSON request payload encoding now defaults to compact separators, allows non-ASCII characters without escaping, and disallows NaN/Infinity values.
findings.title: JSON payload serialization parameters updated for compactness and strictness
findings.before: JSON payloads were serialized using default python json settings.
findings.after: JSON payloads are serialized with ensure_ascii=False, compact separators, and allow_nan=False.
findings.scenario: Encoding a dictionary containing non-ASCII characters, NaN, or requiring compact formatting
findings.potential_impact: Consumers sending requests with float NaN or Infinity values will encounter serialization errors, and receiving servers will receive unescaped UTF-8 characters with reduced payload size due to removed whitespace.
findings.review_question: Does the downstream API consumer expect NaN values to be rejected or non-ASCII characters to be unescaped in JSON request bodies?

example.input: Encoding a dictionary containing non-ASCII characters, NaN, or requiring compact formatting
